First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.7 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.7 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.8 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.8 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 970 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (970 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.1 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.1 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 1,950 ms

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Cumulative Layout Shift

Result: 0.129

Why: Page elements are moving unexpectedly during loading (0.129). This can make the page difficult to use and can cause accidental clicks.

Speed Index

Result: 7.5 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.5 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.3 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.3 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 8.7 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 8.7 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 6.7 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (6.7 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 3.0 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 3.0 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 7.8 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 7.8 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Total Blocking Time

Result: 300 ms

Why: The browser is spending too much time executing long JavaScript tasks (300 ms). This delays user interaction.

How to fix: Reduce JavaScript execution, remove unused JavaScript, split large bundles, defer non-critical scripts, and reduce third-party JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.2 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.2 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.

First Contentful Paint

Result: 5.2 s

Why: The first visible content is taking 5.2 s to appear. This can make the page feel slow when users first open it.

How to fix: Reduce render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, optimize above-the-fold images, preload important resources, and remove unnecessary third-party scripts.

Largest Contentful Paint

Result: 5.6 s

Why: The main visible content is taking 5.6 s to appear. A slow Largest Contentful Paint usually means the main image, heading, or other large element is loading too late.

How to fix: Optimize the main hero image, use WebP or AVIF, preload the LCP resource when appropriate, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-critical JavaScript.

Speed Index

Result: 7.6 s

Why: Visible page content is appearing slowly (7.6 s), so users may see an incomplete page for longer.

How to fix: Optimize above-the-fold images, reduce render-blocking resources, inline critical CSS, and defer non-critical assets.
